_comment: 🧩️ Artifact-level contribution: the native packages this artifact's test adapters may reach. Host-package resolution walks from the CASE OWNER (this artifact root) up through the contributions whose owner is a prefix of it, so a declaration made in the subset manifest below would never be seen — that manifest carries the catalog and the no-oracle decision, this one carries the host wiring. `semio-s-plugin-animate` itself is not listed: the generated host discovers the subject crate on its own and links it only under its `sut` feature.
